title: 第262章 一招败第261章 快请大师
slug: 觉醒阴阳神功分手后我爽麻了
content_zh:
推荐各位书友阅读：觉醒阴阳神功：分手后我爽麻了第一卷：默认第262章一招败（..la）就在两人对话之际，一道浑厚霸道的怒吼骤然传来：“哪里走？”
话音落下，一道魁梧身影踏空掠来，身形沉稳有力，稳稳落在陈阳对面的空地上，落地带起一阵轻微劲风。
来人正是萧戮，他身形高大魁梧，肩宽背厚，一身黑色劲装勾勒出结实饱满的肌肉线条。
肌肤黝黑硬朗，面容粗犷凌厉，眼神锐利如鹰，周身萦绕着厚重沉稳的灵力气息，压迫感十足。
全场所有人的目光瞬间全部聚焦在萧戮身上，气氛压抑到了极点。
葛少威看着强势登场的萧戮，心底暗自窃喜，眼底闪过贪婪，暗暗盘算：楚青辞，今晚我一定要得到你，现在就让你好好见识一下我葛家真正的底气。
他立刻对着萧戮高声喊道：“大师，快废掉这个不知天高地厚的小子，让他知道我们葛家的厉害！”
萧戮目光沉沉，缓缓落在陈阳身上，从头到脚仔细打量了一遍。
方才他一直在车内闭目打坐，却时刻留意着外面的动静。
陈阳和葛少威发生的所有冲突，他全都听得一清二楚。
此刻看清陈阳这般年轻的模样，他心底不由得生出几分意外，没想到闹出这么大动静的人，居然是一个年纪轻轻的少年。
与此同时，陈阳悄然运转透视能力，瞬间就探查清对方的修为底细。
只见这萧戮正是炼气境八层前期高手。
陈阳心底当下安定不少，他如今是炼气境八层中期，虽说只比对方高一小段境界，但根基、底蕴和战力，都有着天壤之别，完全不惧对方。
陈阳不再拖沓，身形一闪，主动走到空地正中央。
他心念一动，催动绝学，背后虚空微微震颤，八道莹白剔透的灵力光手缓缓延伸浮现，悬浮于空，气息磅礴浩荡。
一股极强的灵力威压瞬间席卷全场。
在场所有人都被这股磅礴的力量震慑，呼吸微微一滞。
陆霜瞳孔骤缩，失声惊呼而出：“这是灵域门的独门绝学，神仙八手！”
看着悬浮半空、威势骇人的八道灵力光手，萧戮眼底闪过浓浓的诧异，心里全然没料到一个年纪轻轻的少年，居然能施展出这般强横的功法。

但他毕竟是老牌八层修士，底气依旧充足，身形一闪，稳稳掠到陈阳对面，摆开架势准备迎战。
没有多余试探，陈阳心念一动，操控八道莹白光手同时破空而出，带着呼啸劲风，齐齐朝着萧戮狠狠轰击过去。
“喝！”
萧戮厉声大喝一声，全身灵力瞬间暴涨，体表灵光疯狂涌动，飞速在身前凝出一面厚重坚实的灵力光盾，通体莹亮，牢牢护住全身。
砰砰砰——！
八道光手接连狠狠拍击在光盾之上。
密集的爆破声接连炸响，坚固的屏障瞬间剧烈震颤，表层灵光疯狂溃散，密密麻麻的裂纹快速蔓延开来。
萧戮脸色骤变，这一刻他才猛然察觉，自己从一开始就低估了对方的实力。
他不敢大意，咬牙催动全身灵力，疯狂给光盾输送力量，想要强行稳住防御。
可陈阳这八道光手的爆发力，早已远超他的承受极限。
仅仅一瞬，布满裂纹的光盾就轰然碎裂。
剩余的磅礴力道不减分毫，狠狠拍打在萧戮的胸膛之上。
content_en:
Recommended reading for all book friends: Awakening of the Yin-Yang Magic: I felt so good after the breakup, Volume 1: Default Chapter 262: Defeat with one move (..la) Just as the two were talking, a thick and domineering roar suddenly came: "Where to go?"
As he finished speaking, a burly figure flew through the air. His figure was steady and powerful, and he landed steadily on the open space opposite Chen Yang, causing a slight strong wind when he landed.
The person who came was none other than Xiao Lu. He was tall and burly, with broad shoulders and a thick back. He was dressed in black clothes that outlined strong and full muscle lines.
The skin is dark and tough, the face is rough and sharp, the eyes are as sharp as an eagle, and there is a heavy and steady aura of spiritual power lingering around him, which is full of oppression.
The eyes of everyone in the room were instantly focused on Xiao Lu, and the atmosphere was extremely depressing.
Ge Shaowei looked at Xiao Lu, who made a strong appearance, and secretly rejoiced in his heart. Greed flashed in his eyes, and he secretly calculated: Chu Qingci, I must get you tonight, and now let you see the true strength of my Ge family.
He immediately shouted to Xiao Lu: "Master, quickly get rid of this ignorant boy and let him know how powerful our Ge family is!"
Xiao Lu's eyes fell heavily on Chen Yang and he looked at him carefully from head to toe.
He had been meditating with his eyes closed in the car just now, but he was always paying attention to what was going on outside.
He heard clearly all the conflicts between Chen Yang and Ge Shaowei.
Seeing Chen Yang's young appearance at this moment, he couldn't help but feel a little surprised in his heart. He didn't expect that the person who made such a big fuss was actually a young boy.
At the same time, Chen Yang quietly used his clairvoyance ability and instantly found out the details of the opponent's cultivation level.
I saw that this Xiao Lu was a master at the early stage of the eighth level of Qi Refining Realm.
Chen Yang felt much more at peace in his heart. He was now in the middle of the eighth level of Qi Refining Realm. Although he was only a little higher than the opponent, his foundation, heritage and combat power were all very different, and he was not afraid of the opponent at all.
Chen Yang stopped procrastinating and took the initiative to walk to the center of the open space.
With a thought in his mind, he activated his special skill, and the void behind him trembled slightly. Eight crystal-white spiritual light hands slowly extended and emerged, suspended in the air, with a majestic and majestic breath.
An extremely strong spiritual pressure swept the entire place instantly.
Everyone present was shocked by this majestic power, and their breathing was slightly stagnant.
Lu Shuang's pupils shrank suddenly, and she exclaimed in surprise: "This is the unique secret skill of the Spirit Realm Sect, the Eight Hands of the Immortal!"
Looking at the terrifying eight-ray spiritual power light hand suspended in mid-air, Xiao Lu's eyes flashed with deep surprise. He never expected that a young boy could actually perform such a powerful technique.
But after all, he was a veteran eighth-level monk, and he still had enough confidence. With a flash of his body, he moved steadily to the opposite side of Chen Yang, getting ready to fight.
Without any unnecessary temptation, Chen Yang made a thought and controlled eight rays of white light to shoot out of the air at the same time. With a roaring wind, they all struck towards Xiao Lu fiercely.
"Drink!"
Xiao Lu shouted loudly, and his spiritual power surged instantly. The spiritual light on his body surged crazily, and a thick and solid spiritual power light shield quickly formed in front of him. The whole body was bright and shining, firmly protecting his whole body.
Bang bang bang——!
Eight light hands slapped hard on the light shield one after another.
Intense explosions exploded one after another, the solid barrier trembled violently in an instant, the aura on the surface collapsed crazily, and dense cracks spread rapidly.
Xiao Lu's expression suddenly changed, and at this moment he suddenly realized that he had underestimated the opponent's strength from the beginning.
He didn't dare to be careless. He gritted his teeth and activated all his spiritual power, frantically sending power to the light shield, trying to forcibly stabilize the defense.
But the explosive power of Chen Yang's eight-ray hand had already far exceeded his endurance limit.
In just a moment, the cracked light shield shattered.
The remaining majestic force was not reduced at all, and it slapped Xiao Lu's chest hard.
